messages:
maria_sales: Raj on the demo is hitting auth errors and intermittent 429s. Error text: '403 project claim mismatch'. Can infra triage quickly?

raj_acme: Getting "403 Forbidden: project claim does not match request" when calling /v1/generate. Using key from the portal and header X-Redwood-Project: acme-main. Also saw some 429 bursts during parallel requests.

maria_sales: can you paste the sanitized curl you ran?

raj_acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.test.ZZZZ" -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-main" -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"hello"}'

hayley_se: quick note: presales/trial keys sometimes bind to an internal demo project name. We recently tightened enforcement so header must match bound project exactly (case-sensitive).

kevin_platform: auth logs show: 
```
auth_check: key=sk.test.ZZZZ bound_project=acme-demo-42 tenant=acme-org
request: header_project=acme-main scopes=[generate,embeddings]
decision: DENY (project mismatch)
```
Looks like the key is bound to acme-demo-42.

raj_acme: if I switch header to acme-demo-42 it works?

tom_support: try this: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.test.ZZZZ" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-demo-42" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"hello"}'
```

raj_acme: changed header and get 200. Ok. But their CI uses acme-main and they don't want to change.

maria_sales: can we rebind the key to acme-main? Also they hit spikes of 120rpm during load demo and saw 429s. Any overlap?

kevin_platform: two separate things: 429s from free-tier throttle (60rpm) — their demo spawns 8 concurrent streams pushing bursts. We can apply a demo uplift or issue a short-lived high-throttle key. Rebind is possible but needs an audit entry. Do we have approval?

hayley_se: customer also asked about permission scopes. Their security team wanted assurance the key only had generate scope and cannot call admin endpoints. This key's scopes are [generate, embeddings] — it does NOT have admin or billing scopes. We'll include scope list in the audit.

maria_sales: customer approves rebind + demo uplift for 3 hours. Please include audit of who rebounded/rotated.

kevin_platform: performing rebind now. action_id=reb_7782. Applying demo uplift to 300rpm until 2025-02-15T21:00:00Z.

audit_bot: Action recorded: reb_7782 by kevin_platform at 2025-02-15T18:04:40Z. Key scopes: [generate, embeddings]. Previous binding: acme-demo-42. New binding: acme-main.

kevin_platform: rebind complete. Also increased throttle for tenant acme-org during uplift window.

raj_acme: confirmed 200 OK with header acme-main and streaming responses. No more 429s during the demo.

hayley_se: follow-up items: 1) we'll send a short security note about scope enforcement and audit logs, 2) sales to provide pricing ballpark for sustained 10 qps, 3) we should fix portal UX to show both demo/internal project id and friendly project name to avoid confusion.

maria_sales: I'll send pricing and the security note to Raj. Thanks everyone, closing this swarm. :thumbsup:
